We design it. We build it. You move in.

Faodail Creatives LTD is a design and build company in Nairobi, Kenya, delivering homes, townhouses and apartments from first sketch to final handover.

Call +254 740 433 387See our work

One team from drawing board to keys.

Working with a separate architect and contractor means two sets of people to coordinate. With us, the team that designs your project is the team that builds it, so what you approve on paper is what stands on your plot.

We work on private residences, estates of townhouses and multi-storey apartment blocks.

Architectural design

Concept sketches, 3D renderings and full working drawings, so you can see the finished building before the first foundation is dug.

Construction

Turnkey building of villas, maisonettes and apartment blocks, with site supervision from groundbreaking to completion.

Interior design

Living spaces planned with built-in joinery, feature lighting and finishes that match the architecture.

Landscaping and pools

Driveways, gardens, timber decks and swimming pools designed together with the house.

How a project runs

Brief

We visit the plot and listen to what you need and what you can spend.

Design

Plans and 3D views, revised until you are happy.

Approvals

Drawings prepared for submission to the relevant authorities.

Build

Construction with regular site updates.

Handover

Final inspection, then the keys are yours.
